decisions.justification: In compliance with clinical brief Rule 5, no arbitrary dropping of rare classes in the raw/cleaned base data. Preserving all 46 disease categories.
All 174 feature names already follow standard snake_case without whitespace.
All symptom features strictly verified as binary indicator variables {0, 1}.
Raw dataset contains 0 missing values across all 17,500,000 cells. No synthetic imputation required.
Zero exact duplicates and zero identical symptom vectors exist in the 100,000 records. Every record represents a distinct symptom combination.
Zero constant columns found; all 174 symptom features exhibit non-zero variance.
Casting 174 binary int64 columns to uint8 reduces in-memory footprint from ~145 MB to ~24 MB while preserving exact values.
All cases have at least 1 reported symptom. Maximum is 97. No empty records exist.

summary: Full raw dataset validated and converted to optimized parquet. Zero missing values, zero duplicates, zero constant columns, all 174 binary features and 46 classes preserved.
